This release has ended (2026-10-06). Its sealing key is scheduled for deletion or deleted; a vault still sealed to it can no longer be opened.

Changes

  • Connection requests, with a short code that both people compare before they connect (VAULT-MESSAGING 0.10.2 and 0.10.3).
  • The release number and the release automation signing key are built into the image.
  • Built from vettid-vault commit bf0cc31 (tag release/staging/2) and independently rebuilt on 2026-10-05 with a matching PCR0.
